_comment: The game-version ledger (U04 of docs/SEASON_UPDATES.md): the pinned simulator, the card tables it carries, the client builds known and accepted, the season rule and the dated content events. tools/game_versions.py reads it; tools/game_update.py check compares PyPI, the official API's /v1/cards and the device's client build against it.

pin: the royalesim release and cards.CARD_TABLE arm every tool runs (requirements/engine.txt, requirements/gpu.txt, pyproject.toml and data/engine.json say the same; tests/pipeline/test_game_versions.py checks it). Promote (U12) moves it and appends to pin_history.

royalesim.<version>: read from that release's PyPI sdist (data/calibration.json cards.CARD_TABLE and every data/derived/cards-*.json). fnv1a64 is FNV-1a 64 of the table file's bytes, which is what Battle.card_table_fnv1a64() reports (docs/SEASON_UPDATES.md 3.3: a table's name is not its identity). client_build and content are the table's own provenance text (MANIFEST.json build and content_version).

clients: client builds by versionCode (encoding MM mmmm bbb: 160635001 = 16.635.1). accepted is the date a build was judged fine to play against the pinned table; basis is table (the pinned table's own build), owner (scripts/game_update.ps1 -AcceptClient -Note) or history (seen, never accepted). A build the daily check records by itself (basis auto) goes to <runs>/updates/clients.json, not here, so the scheduled task never dirties the tree.

seasons: a season starts on the first Monday of each month; observed lists the 2026 starts the rule must reproduce. content_events: dated balance updates, new cards and new forms. table names the arm that carries an event's content (null: no table has it yet). Dates are UTC days. Facts marked confirmed false come from search snippets (docs/SEASON_UPDATES.md 14.11): re-check them on the PC.

il_replay: the Hugging Face dataset the imitation rows come from. revision null means not recorded yet: the first check that reaches the Hugging Face API records the latest revision in <runs>/updates/state.json and reports later changes.

pin.basis: docs/SPARRING_PLAN.md: the 16.402.22 table is the target; the owner judged that nothing major changed for the bot since the 2026-10-19 balance update

pin_history.note: first pin of the sparring fork (batch 2: engine factory and data/engine.json)

client160402017.note: the install-time pack; read from a checkout only, a wheel carries no copy of it

0.1.42.source: read on 2026-10-30 from the PyPI sdist, whose sha256 matched PyPI's digest. Each table's FNV-1a 64 equals the Battle.card_table_fnv1a64() value docs/SEASON_UPDATES.md 3.3 expects; the engine itself was not run (the stage, U09, probes it).

royaleimitate.note: the same file in the 0.2.15 sdist and wheel (tools/rs_cards.py VENDORED_SHA256)

clients.note: the build the 160402017 tables are named after
the pinned table's own build: cards-160402017-20261019.1 was decoded from client build 160402020, content 16.402.22

clients.source: measured on the PC by scripts/selfcheck.py on 2026-10-29; APKMirror upload 2026-10-27
clients.note: a newer client line than any table (16.635 against 16.402). The owner judged that nothing major changed for the bot since the 2026-10-19 balance update (docs/SPARRING_PLAN.md).

seasons.source: docs/SEASON_UPDATES.md 3.1 (web research): the rule reproduces all eleven 2026 season starts

content_events.source: docs/SEASON_UPDATES.md 2 and 3.1; MinionGiant is in every 0.1.42 table but cards-2018 (catalogue id 132)
the table's own provenance (royalesim 0.1.42 sdist); docs/SEASON_UPDATES.md 3.2

content_events.what: Season 88 mid-season balance update, content 16.402.22 (November's changes moved here)
content_events.source: the table's own provenance (royalesim 0.1.42 sdist); docs/SEASON_UPDATES.md 2 and 3.2

content_events.what: Season 89: Evo Giant and Evo Mirror; reported without balance changes

il_replay.note: tools/il_replay_download.py fetches the main branch and records no revision, so the PC's copy has none. The check reads https://huggingface.co/api/datasets/VanguardX101/IL_Replay (sha, lastModified) when it answers.
